## Your browser, supercharged

Lite Agent is the only extension that combines AI chat, page automation, voice input, memory, and encrypted backups in one tool.

### Page automation

Click, type, scroll, take screenshots, navigate, and run code on any page. The agent sees what you see and acts on your behalf — analyzing articles, filling forms, and sending emails.

### Smart memory

Stores facts, preferences, and notes across sessions. The agent searches its memory before every reply so nothing gets lost. Browse, search, and manage everything from the memory panel.

### Easy setup & customization

Connect your account in seconds with the setup wizard. Customize the sidebar look with a prompt — the agent styles itself. Themes persist across sessions.

## Talk to your browser

Press a key, speak, and let Lite Agent handle the rest. Real-time transcription, voice activity detection, and audio playback built right into the chat.

Speech captured via Web Speech API, transcribed as you talk.

Voice activity detection stops recording after 1.2s of quiet.

Voice notes play inline in chat. Transcript sent silently to the AI.

## Be the first to try it.

Drop your email and we'll send you an invite the moment the extension is ready. No spam, no resold lists.
